tolerance: rtol=atol=1e-10; execution timings and freeze timestamps excluded. Configuration hashes include the timestamp, so stable configuration fields are compared directly.
method: Fresh output directory: full one-command run completed search and CV, then was interrupted during final evaluation. Final stage resumed with the same frozen configuration; all numerical tables and prediction arrays match the original run. No test-driven retuning.
notebook_execution: Code cells executed in order in a shared Python namespace with captured stdout and Matplotlib figures. Jupyter UI/kernel launch itself was not tested on this host.
